controls.title: [IAM] Ensure that there are only GCP-managed service account keys for each service account
controls.desc: User managed service account should not have user managed keys.

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data: User managed service account should not have user managed keys.

descriptions.label: rationale
descriptions.data: Anyone who has access to the keys will be able to access resources through the service account.

controls.title: [LOGGING] Ensure that sinks are configured for all log entries
controls.desc: It is recommended to create a sink that will export copies of all the log entries.

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data: It is recommended to create a sink that will export copies of all the log entries.

descriptions.label: fix
descriptions.data: Create an aggregated export sink at the organization level with an empty filter.

results.code_desc: [example-project] Log sinks should include a sink with an empty filter
